ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens with frilly, serrated edges, some leaves bright green, scattered thin red strips (possibly pepper pieces) mixed in, moist with slight sheen, spread across the upper-left center of a white square plate covering roughly 35% of plate area, leaves about 5-12 cm long, piled roughly 2-3 cm high | 110

ITEM 2 | Pale wilted greens with thick white-green stems, limp and glossy, folded in a band along the lower-left edge of the plate, covering about 10% of plate area, piled about 1-2 cm high, next to the leafy greens | 45

ITEM 3 | Golden-brown cooked piece with a crumbly, coarse breaded or crumb-like topping in tan and light brown, bits of green visible within, pale cream-colored meat underneath with a browned edge, lying on the lower-right of the plate covering about 10% of plate area, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm, about 2-3 cm thick | 85
